//: The export queue worker. Apply with: northflank create service combined --project beff -f deploy/northflank/service-worker.json
//why-separate: Same image as the API, different command — exactly as docker-compose.yml does it. Building a second image for one entry point would guarantee the two drift apart, and the worker shares the models, repositories and ExportService.
//scaling: `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` means a second replica steps over whatever the first has claimed rather than blocking behind it, so scaling this is `instances: 2` and nothing else.
//no-ports: Deliberately empty. The worker polls the database; nothing calls it, so it has no reason to be reachable.
//plan: nf-compute-10 (0.1 vCPU / 256 MB) — it wakes every 2s, asks one question and sleeps. It does not need what the API needs.
name: beff-worker
description: Drains the GDPR export queue. Postgres-backed, no Redis (ADR-0006).
